name: Avellaneda (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a blue chevron resting on the lower edge, charged with three yellow flowers, beneath a blue wavy stripe.
history: The arms and the flag were approved in 2014 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 76 of 22 April 2015); the flag is a square white flag of 1:1 with a blue chevron laid on the lower edge, one fifth of the height in width.

features.role: chevron resting on the lower edge with three yellow flowers
